description: One third-party audit or agency inspection: who came, when, what they looked at, what they found, and whether every finding was ever closed. The corrective actions are the part that matters — an operation is not judged on having no findings, it is judged on closing them.

fields.description: What this audit was, said once: 'PrimusGFS 2026 — Highland Ranch', 'ODA Pesticide Inspection 2026-06-14'. The docname is built from it.
fields.label: Audit Name

fields.description: Which regime. Drives which audit packet includes it: an FSMA packet takes FSMA and FDA inspections, a GAP packet takes GAP, GlobalGAP and PrimusGFS.
fields.label: Audit Type
fields.options:
FSMA
GAP
GlobalGAP
PrimusGFS
Organic
OSHA
USDA
DOL
EPA
ODA
FDA
Buyer Audit
Internal Audit
Other

fields.description: Who did it — the auditor's name, and the firm if they are not the same. The person a disputed finding is argued with.
fields.label: Auditor

fields.description: The date they were on the ground. What an audit packet's period filter matches against.
fields.label: Audit Date

fields.description: What the audit concluded, in the scheme's own vocabulary where it has one. Pending means the report has not arrived yet, which is a real and common state for weeks after the visit.
fields.label: Result
fields.options:
Pending
Passed
Passed With Conditions
Failed
Not Scored

fields.description: What they actually looked at — which blocks, which buildings, which records, which period. An audit of the packing house is not evidence about the camp, and a packet that presented it as such would be misleading.
fields.label: Scope

fields.description: The findings as written, in full. The narrative; the individual items that need fixing go in the corrective actions table below, where each one can be tracked to a closure.
fields.label: Findings

fields.description: One row per thing that has to be fixed. This table is why the doctype exists: an operation is not judged on having no findings, it is judged on closing them, and an open action nobody can produce evidence for is what turns last year's finding into this year's penalty.
fields.label: Corrective Actions Required

fields.description: The date every corrective action was closed and the audit was done with. Set by close_audit_event, which refuses while any action is still open — a closure date over an open action is the single most misleading thing this app could record.
fields.label: Corrective Actions Closed

fields.description: How the closure was accepted — the auditor's confirmation email, the certificate that issued, the re-inspection that passed.
fields.label: Closure Note

name: Audit Event
